name: GeoAgent Optimizer Lite
author: gokalp99

sections.description:
Traditional SEO is evolving into GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization).

GeoAgent Optimizer Lite is an essential tool designed to make your WordPress site fully compatible with modern AI bots like ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google Gemini.

By structuring your content and managing bot crawl signals, this plugin ensures that Large Language Models (LLMs) can easily discover, read, and cite your website as a reliable source in their generated answers.

Core Features

  • AI Bot Tracking: Automatically detects and logs visits from major AI crawlers (ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, etc.).
  • Virtual Sitemap Injector: Ensures your sitemaps are easily discoverable by autonomous agents.
  • Auto-Heal robots.txt: Dynamically injects the Content-Signal directive to guide AI training and search bot behavior without modifying physical files.
  • Markdown Engine: Allows LLMs to consume your content in a clean, token-efficient Markdown format, bypassing standard HTML overhead.
  • Clean & Lightweight: Operates with zero impact on your site’s performance.

Step into the Agentic Web and ensure your content doesn’t get left behind in AI-driven search results.
